question: What mantra is used when offering the mung-bean oblation?
premises: Acceptance is demanded with huṃ and phaḍ.
The formula is identified as a deva-syllabled mantra.
inference: The mung-bean offering is given with this deva-syllabled mantra.
plain_english: Take, take this mung-bean offering — huṃ, phaḍ — this is the deva-syllabled mantra.
